nodes.label: ctr CLI
nodes.desc: ctr run builds the OCI spec and asks the daemon to create and start a container (var Command, L96)

nodes.label: containerd main()
nodes.desc: Daemon entrypoint: builds the server, then srv.Start(ctx) and srv.Wait() serve forever (L260, L266)

nodes.label: Server + plugin registry
nodes.desc: Server.New wires config into plugin InitContexts and LoadPlugins (L313) instantiates every registered service plugin

nodes.label: Tasks gRPC service
nodes.desc: io.containerd.runtime.v1.tasks plugin registered at L36; Register (L57) exposes Create/Start/Delete/Kill on the gRPC server

nodes.label: Content gRPC service
nodes.desc: Content service (ID "content", L31) wraps the content.Store behind contentserver.New (L40)

nodes.label: Snapshots gRPC service
nodes.desc: Serves every snapshotter registered in the metadata DB via m.(*metadata.DB).Snapshotters() (L40)

nodes.label: Events gRPC service
nodes.desc: NewService (L66) binds the event exchange; RegisterTTRPC (L80) also serves it to shims over ttrpc

nodes.label: TaskManager
nodes.desc: NewTaskManager (L138) routes task RPCs to the right per-container shim by namespace and container ID

nodes.label: ShimManager
nodes.desc: NewShimManager (L157) tracks shim binaries; Start (L205) launches a shim per container and connects to it

nodes.label: containerd-shim-runc-v2
nodes.desc: Out-of-process shim: main (L29) calls shim.RunShim with manager.NewShimManager("io.containerd.runc.v2") (L30)

nodes.label: Snapshotter interface
nodes.desc: The Prepare/View/Commit contract (L281) every storage driver implements for container root filesystems

nodes.label: bolt metadata DB
nodes.desc: NewDB (L120) creates the single bolt database holding containers, images, namespaces and snapshot keys
